--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M5PSSK1HD9DVYPW7WQHGFAJC
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: Refuse an in-band wait only for the same session, with a Router-owned mark
+---
+## What
+
+Remove the queue re-entry refusal from Router. Keep the one real rule with a Router-owned mark: a tool must not wait in-band for its OWN session, because that session cannot start its next answer while the tool runs inside the current one.
+
+Today Router uses Extras' `ModelCallMark` and `SubmissionTarget` for two checks:
+- the queue check: a wait for any session on the same model is refused (`RoutedSessionActorGeneration.swift:242-247`)
+- the same-session check
+
+The Extras task "Delete the per-model generation queue and ModelCallMark, after Router stops using them" (01M5PSQ2YCRA2BW4ZMXMB9Y6QY) deletes those types. It needs this task first.
+
+- [ ] Add a Router task-local, for example `SessionCallMark(sessionID:)` in `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/`. Bind it in the task-local wrapper `Self.submission(...)` (`RoutedSessionActorAnswerExecution.swift` 946-977) in place of `ModelCallMark`.
+- [ ] `RoutedSessionActorGeneration.swift:232-247`: refuse an in-band wait only when the mark names the session that is waited for. Remove `refuseWaitInsideOpenSubmission()` and the queue check.
+- [ ] Remove each use of `ModelCallMark`, `SubmissionTarget` and `isOpenModelCall(of:)`: `RoutedSessionActorAnswerExecution.swift:761, 838` and `RoutedSessionActorCompaction.swift:96, 457`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] An in-band tool body that waits for an other routed session on the same model gets the result: not refused, no deadlock.
+- [ ] An in-band tool body that waits for its own session is refused with a clear error. Keep the present error type and text if possible.
+- [ ] `rg -n 'ModelCallMark|SubmissionTarget|refuseWaitInsideOpenSubmission|isOpenModelCall' Sources Tests` finds nothing in Router.
+- [ ] Each task-local of the wrapper still has its value in a tool body (a test reads `ToolContext` and `SessionOwnWork`).
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] Restate `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/GenerationQueueSubmissionTests.swift`: `anInBandWaitForASessionOnTheSameModelIsRefused` becomes "...is answered", and `anInBandWaitForABusySessionOnTheSameModelIsRefused` becomes "...is answered after its turn". Add: an in-band wait for its own session is refused.
+- [ ] Restate `NestedGenerationReentryTests` and `HumanWaitGateTests` as necessary.
+- [ ] `swift test` in FoundationModelsRouter: all tests pass, with no new warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+
+- Use `/tdd`: write the failing tests first, then implement until they pass.
+- After the push, tell the user that the Extras delete task can start. #no-queue
\ No newline at end of file
